name: Wrapped Savings rUSD
oneLiner: wsrUSD is a non-rebasing ERC-4626 savings wrapper of Reservoir's rUSD stablecoin, accruing yield from T-bill, DeFi lending, and basis strategies behind rUSD.
collateral: T-bills and government securities (RWA allocation via governance-approved Asset Adapters), overcollateralized DeFi lending in Morpho and Euler vaults (curators include Steakhouse, Re7, MEV Capital, Gauntlet, Objective Labs), and crypto funding-rate / basis strategies; Credit Enforcer smart contracts enforce minimum 105% Liquidity, Solvency, and Capital Ratios before any leverage-increasing action
pegMechanism: wsrUSD is a non-rebasing ERC-4626 vault token that accepts rUSD and accrues yield per block; token price appreciates continuously from $1.00 as protocol yield accrues, and users can redeem wsrUSD for rUSD at any time. rUSD itself is minted and redeemed through Reservoir's Peg Stability Module (PSM) against supported stablecoins, subject to available protocol liquidity.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Wrapped Savings rUSD is deployed across many chains and the L2BEAT candidate route resolves Across liquidity/intent routing. The reviewed profile treats cross-chain movement as liquidity/intent route exposure rather than issuer-native finality.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-7 (lead pyusd-paypal)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-derived 2026-07-31 across the tracked wrapper surfaces. Reservoir's verified Savingcoin source for Ethereum wsrUSD is a constructor-deployed ERC-4626/ERC20 with MANAGER and DEFAULT_ADMIN roles for cap/rate/update/recovery operations, but no blacklist, freeze, pause, seize, or arbitrary-holder-burn function; the 15 EVM representation deployments use the same 12,275-byte LayerZero OFT code family with ordinary transfer paths. Solana finalized slot 436244454 (2026-07-30T23:20:08Z) for mint 7bxM8cRF... reports freezeAuthority = null. The wrapper therefore has no current local holder-freeze reach. Upstream access is inherited from tracked rUSD: Tempo rUSD TIP-20 currently reads paused() = false and transferPolicyId() = 1 at block 32494649, but the Reservoir admin can activate TIP-403 blacklist/transfer policy, pause, or burnBlocked controls under the TIP-20 standard. Failure domain is the Reservoir rUSD parent/Tempo admin, not wsrUSD's wrapper or OFT contracts.

mintAuthority.summary: wsrUSD is a non-upgradeable Savingcoin ERC-4626 wrapper minted by depositing rUSD. Its active MANAGER role is held by Reservoir Safe 0x4E8a4894... (3-of-5), while DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE remains with EOA 0xb7570e32... and can grant or revoke MANAGER. Base mint authority is inherited from rUSD.

controls.label: wsrUSD Savingcoin ERC-4626 wrapper (non-upgradeable)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531314, Blockscout and RPC evidence confirm a constructor-deployed Savingcoin contract with no proxy or upgrade path. asset() returns rUSD 0x09D4214C03D01F49544C0448DBE3A27f768F2b34, and wrapper shares are minted through ERC-4626 deposits rather than a privileged net-claim mint surface.

controls.label: wsrUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531314, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xb7570e32ded63b25163369d5eb4d8e89e70e5602) returned true and eth_getCode returned 0x, confirming an EOA. MANAGER is administered by DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so this EOA can grant or revoke the active MANAGER Safe.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531314, wsrUSD remains an immutable constructor-deployed Savingcoin ERC-4626 wrapper over rUSD. Reservoir Safe 0x4E8a4894275780f571AaD53122e641D9f50Ff04f actively holds MANAGER and is 3-of-5 with no enabled modules, while EOA 0xb7570e32ded63b25163369d5eb4d8e89e70e5602 still holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and can grant or revoke MANAGER. The wrapper has no privileged net-claim mint surface; base rUSD controls remain tracked on the parent. Re-verified at Ethereum block 25575162 on 2026-07-20: wsrUSD 0xd3fd63209fa2d55b07a0f6db36c2f43900be3094 still reads a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot, confirming the wrapper is still the immutable constructor-deployed contract, its asset() still resolves to rUSD 0x09D4214C03D01F49544C0448DBE3A27f768F2b34, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xb7570e32ded63b25163369d5eb4d8e89e70e5602) is still true, and the MANAGER Safe 0x4E8a4894275780f571AaD53122e641D9f50Ff04f still returns getThreshold() = 3 over five owners. Economic-control adjudication: the wrapper mints shares only against rUSD actually deposited into it and exposes no privileged net-claim mint entry point, so its own cap is economically bounded; the unbounded issuer discretion sits on the parent rUSD profile, where it is scored. As a pure on-chain ERC-4626 wrapper there is no separate supply-versus-reserve attestation cadence for wsrUSD, and no financial regulator supervises Reservoir.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
reserveReview.rationale: The verified wsrUSD ERC-4626 wrapper reports rUSD as its underlying asset; asset() on 0xd3fd63209fa2d55b07a0f6db36c2f43900be3094 returned rUSD 0x09D4214C03D01F49544C0448DBE3A27f768F2b34 when re-read via public RPC on 2026-07-20, and Reservoir's product documentation re-fetched today confirms wsrUSD is minted with rUSD and redeemable for rUSD at any time up to available PSM liquidity. The direct wsrUSD reserve is therefore one 100% wrapper position linked to tracked asset rusd-reservoir; the underlying rUSD basket is inherited and is not duplicated here. The parent rUSD composition was re-aligned to the 2026-07-20 Reservoir API on this same date (USD1 bucket fell from 8.4% to 2.1%).
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Verified wsrUSD ERC-4626 asset() relationship (public RPC read 2026-07-20) and Reservoir reserve documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The direct dependency is fully identified as rUSD, but the underlying rUSD reserve composition, strategy allocation, and legal custody terms remain upstream facts tracked on the rusd-reservoir record.

providers.name: Reservoir wsrUSD Savingcoin ERC-4626 wrapper contract 0xd3fd63209fa2d55b07a0f6db36c2f43900be3094 (self-custodied; wraps rUSD held in upstream Reservoir protocol contracts)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: wsrUSD's only direct reserve is rUSD deposited in the non-upgradeable ERC-4626 wrapper contract (asset() = rUSD 0x09D4214C03D01F49544C0448DBE3A27f768F2b34, re-verified 2026-07-20), so custody of the economic backing is inherited entirely from rUSD: the upstream Reservoir balance sheet sits in protocol-controlled adapter contracts with no named third-party custodian, trust, SPV, or holder claim documented in the ToS (2024-08-23) or product docs. The wrapper itself does not re-lend its rUSD, but the upstream rUSD reserve model is active re-deployment into lending markets, vaults, and RWA credit, so rehypothecation is marked permitted at the economic level. Redemption is documented as immediate only up to available PSM liquidity. Wrapper parameters (setCap, update) are governed by the 3-of-5 MANAGER Safe 0x4E8a4894275780f571AaD53122e641D9f50Ff04f, while DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE remains with EOA 0xb7570e32 and can grant or revoke MANAGER (mint-authority review, 2026-07-14). No bankruptcy-remoteness structure for wsrUSD holders is documented.
